news.title: Acworth Chick-fil-A stabbing: Mother talks about parking lot attack
news.summary: A mother who says she was repeatedly stabbed by her own daughter during a stop at an Acworth Chick-fil-A is speaking out about the attack and says she does not feel safe.

news.title: Suspect dead in triple shooting in Gwinnett County identified, another taken into custody
news.summary: The Gwinnett County Police Department have identified the deceased person in the Sept. 6 triple shooting as 23-year-old Marvin Wiley from Atlanta.

news.title: Shooting in Buford leaves 1 dead, 2 injured during armed robbery, police say
news.summary: A man is dead and two are injured in a Buford shooting, Gwinnett Police report.

news.title: Rideshare driver shot by passenger after getting into argument in Atlanta, police say
news.summary: The passenger got out of the vehicle and then shot the driver.
